meta.siteDescription: Kiramala — a traditional Georgian supra on the riverbank. Main hall and private patskha, one shared menu.

footer.tagline: A table by the river, since 1998

hero.title: Kiramala
hero.tagline: A supra by the riverside — wine, bread, and hospitality in the old Georgian tradition.

story.title: Where we began
story.body: Kiramala grew up on the riverbank as a place where the old rules of the Georgian supra are still kept — home-style cooking, wine pressed by hand, and a respect for guests passed down through generations. Here, a meal at the table isn't just dinner — it's a gathering.

patskha.title: The Patskha
patskha.body: A patskha is a traditional Georgian structure — a round hut with wattle walls and a reed-thatched roof, used for centuries as a place to rest and receive guests. On our grounds, close to the river, we've kept that tradition alive: a small, quiet patskha where the very same menu served in our main hall is set for you, just in a more private circle.

qvevri.title: What is qvevri?
qvevri.body: A qvevri is a large clay vessel buried underground, where wine ferments on its skins for months using a traditional method recognised by UNESCO as intangible cultural heritage.

venue.title: Venue
venue.intro: Kiramala sits on the riverbank — three spaces, one table.

hall.title: Main Dining Hall
hall.body: A hall enclosed in glass, with river views from every table. High ceilings and natural light make it equally suited to a full supra or a small, quiet dinner.

grounds.title: Grounds & Riverbank
grounds.body: The grounds stretch from the building down to the water — a place to walk and unwind before or after the meal.

patskha.title: The Patskha — Private Dining
patskha.body: Deep in the grounds, close to the water, stands a traditional patskha — a round structure with wattle walls and a reed-thatched roof. It isn't a separate concept, just another room of Kiramala: the same menu is served here, in a quieter, more private setting suited to family gatherings or business dinners.
patskha.note: The same menu as the main hall.
